goal: Prevent attackers from disconnecting honest peers who share an IP address, such as via Tor exit nodes
Disconnect only the misbehaving inbound peer instead of all peers connected from the same address
reviewability: Ready for review with nothing known to invalidate reviewing now
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Supports aligning disconnection with peer discouragement rather than legacy address bans (ajtowns)
Verified by testing multiple connections sharing a single IP (maflcko)
Concept approval without detailed rationale (darosior, mzumsande)
Approval from an account with no project history or rationale is omitted from support (Husteem)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes a denial of service vector against honest peers sharing an IP address
Attackers can currently disconnect every honest peer sharing a Tor exit node by sending an invalid message
